facts.fact: 中文：美国总统在椭圆形办公室说，自己时间不多，十五分钟后要见 Bono。
facts.anchor: I’ve got Bono in fifteen minutes.

facts.fact: 中文：西弗吉尼亚州众议员、众议院常设情报特别委员会主席 Wayne D. Skinner 向总统介绍来自 Langley 的 Howard BUTTONFLY。
facts.anchor: Congressman Wayne D. Skinner of West Virginia, Chairman of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence

facts.fact: 中文：BUTTONFLY 说自己的名字是 1963 年进中情局时给的假名，并说自己确有部分苏格兰-爱尔兰血统。
facts.anchor: It’s one hundred percent CIA. Just a pseudonym, a phony made-up name they gave me when I started at the Agency back in ’63.

facts.fact: 中文：BUTTONFLY 说录音是时任站长的官员寄给他的，那人在爆炸后开枪自杀，是他的朋友。
facts.anchor: It was sent to me by the officer who was Chief of Station at the time of the bombing. The one who shot himself. He was a friend.

facts.fact: 中文：BUTTONFLY 播放取自 COS ARISTOTLE 圆珠笔内 SD 微芯片的录音，BLUEBELL 的声音先开口。
facts.anchor: BUTTONFLY pressed PLAY on the recording taken from the SD microchip that had been in COS ARISTOTLE’s ballpoint pen

facts.fact: 中文：录音中 BLUEBELL 拒绝先对特工做更深入背景审查，自称是中情局副局长兼人力资源主管。
facts.anchor: I may be the Associate Deputy Director a the United States Central Intelligence Agency, but I’m also the Chief a Human Resources fer Pete’s sake

facts.fact: 中文：总统宣布启动 Project Greek Island 2.0，所有资金直接来自他的办公室且不入账。
facts.anchor: I’m pulling the trigger on Project Greek Island 2.0, before the Dark Sky Days come and it’s too late. All funding will come directly from my office, unvouchered.

facts.fact: 中文：总统签署桌上的秘密行动授权书（Covert Action Finding），助手拿去复印，他随后给 Skinner 和 BUTTONFLY 各一份。
facts.anchor: He signed the Covert Action Finding sitting on his desk.
